_readme: Units mm, MPa, N/mm (=kJ/m2). Axes: 1 = road/raster, 2 = in-layer transverse, 3 = build (Z). 2D model = layer plane (1-2), plane strain in 3. 'E','nu' = flat (XY) effective values used only for normalisation (l_ch, mu). Replace interface entries with your measured values when available (explicit keys override the rule).

PLA._source: E1=E_YZ, E2=E3=E_Z, X=break_YZ, Y=Z=break_Z: UltiMaker PLA TDS v5.00. G_T from K_Ic~4.2 MPa m^0.5 (SENB, +-45, horizontal) ; G_L from interlayer K_Ic 3.56 MPa m^0.5 (vertical) and interlayer DCB 0.75-2.4 kJ/m2.
PLA._notes: nu: assumption (0.35); G12 Huber estimate; S = 0.84*Y (S/Y of Oz & Ozturk 2023); E2 = E3 transverse isotropy. G_L range for sensitivity: 0.75-3.4 N/mm.

ToughPLA._status: LITERATURE (not in the current pair list)
ToughPLA._source: UltiMaker Tough PLA TDS v2.10: E1=E_YZ 2797, E2=E3=E_Z 2696, X=yield_YZ 47.5, Y=break_Z 32.5 MPa.
ToughPLA._notes: ASSUMED toughness: no orientation-resolved K_Ic found; Tough PLA is reported with toughness comparable to ABS -> G_L, G_T = ~1.3 x PLA. Yield used as X (material yields before break; FFM uses onset of nonlinearity as upper limit).

PETG._source: UltiMaker PETG TDS v1.00: E1=E_YZ 1874, E2=E3=E_Z 1711, X=yield_YZ 50.3, Y=break_Z 19.0 +- 6.4 MPa.
PETG._notes: ASSUMED toughness: G_T ~2 x PLA (notched Charpy 7.9 vs 3.9 kJ/m2 in the same TDS family); G_L as PLA. nu 0.38 typical PETG. Large scatter of Y (+-6.4).

PLA_OzOzturk2023._source: Oz & Ozturk, J Braz Soc Mech Sci Eng 45:399 (2023), Tables 4-5 (wall-only slicing, unidirectional roads).
PLA_OzOzturk2023._notes: Strong elastic anisotropy (E1/E2 = 1.51). nu21 = 0.38 of the paper violates reciprocity; nu12 = 0.42 used, nu21 = 0.28 implied. Toughness as PLA.

PLA_KiendlGao2020._source: Kiendl & Gao, Compos B 180 (2020) 107562, unidirectional PLA without contours (values as tabulated by Seibel & Kiendl, arXiv 2502.19911).
PLA_KiendlGao2020._notes: Upper bound of strength anisotropy (X/Y = 5.5): weakly bonded roads. nu, S assumed.

ABS._source: UltiMaker ABS TDS v5.00 (same family/protocol as PLA, PETG): E_XY 1962, E_YZ 1931, E_Z 1699 MPa; yield YZ 38.2, break Z 19.0 MPa. Toughness: Hart & Wetzel, Eng Fract Mech 177 (2017) 1-13: inter-laminar 0.25, cross-laminar 2.26 kJ/m2 (SENB).
ABS._notes: E1=E_YZ, E2=E3=E_Z; X = yield_YZ (material yields), Y=Z = break_Z; nu 0.35 assumed; S = 0.84*Y; G_L = 0.5 (between Hart&Wetzel 0.25 and SENT 0.24-0.88 kJ/m2; up to ~4 kJ/m2 at high print temperature) -> sensitivity range 0.25-4.0.

PLA/ToughPLA._notes: k = 1 means the interface is as good as the weaker material's road-to-road bond. Your JAST 2026 SLB data -> measured k_G; face-to-face data -> k_sigma (via identify_sigma_c.py).

PLA/PETG._notes: Literature scatter is large: dual-extruded PLA-PETG close to bulk strength (Mater Des 2025, S026412752500108X) vs 1.6 MPa with a standard joint (Materials 18:3846, 2025) -> k_sigma from ~0.1 to ~1: covered by the k grid.

PLA/ABS._notes: Literature: PLA-ABS transitions bond worse than PLA-PETG (SEM, hybrid FDM study, PMC12196661) -> expect low k.

PETG/ABS._notes: Literature: PETG printed on ABS 13.4 +- 4.3 MPa (PMC13075148) -> k_sigma ~ 0.7 w.r.t. min(Y) = 19 MPa; ABS/PETG print-pause-print laminates show good bonding (Eyri 2025). Elastically nearly matched pair (control).
